lecture_title: From Boundary Conditions to the Open-String Spectrum

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: Shows the finite-difference and Riemann-sum rules that support the later continuum limit.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the difference between two neighboring values

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: Shows the pinned and flat endpoint profiles during the Dirichlet--Neumann comparison.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: derivative is zero at the end points

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: Shows the sliding-ring construction used to give free endpoints a concrete mechanical meaning.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: rings which can slide freely up and down

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: Shows the sine and cosine bases associated with the two endpoint classes.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: expand it in a sine series

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: Shows orthogonality and the exceptional normalization of the constant zero mode.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the integral of cosine n sigma cosine m sigma

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: Shows the harmonic-oscillator energy and the frequency read from its quadratic terms.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: this is a harmonic oscillator

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: Shows the isolated-level picture used to distinguish particle-like spectra from dense macroscopic spectra.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: a big gap to the next state

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: Shows the exact relativistic energy being expanded at large longitudinal momentum.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: expand this in inverse powers of p z

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: Shows the residual energy being interpreted as the generator of time evolution.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: energy is Hamiltonian

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: Shows the finite transverse Hamiltonian after the time rescaling.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: ordinary nonrelativistic Hamiltonian in two dimensions

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_11.png
assets.rationale: Shows the bead-and-spring open string beside its discrete energy.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: N mass points and N minus one springs

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_12.png
assets.rationale: Shows the bead-mass and spring-constant scalings chosen for a finite continuum limit.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the mass of each point goes like one over N
assets.caption_hint: Continuum scaling of mass and stiffness

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_13.png
assets.rationale: Shows the sum-to-integral and finite-difference replacements applied to the chain.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: replace the sum by an integral

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_14.png
assets.rationale: Shows the completed continuum energy of the transverse string coordinates.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: this is the energy of the string

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_15.png
assets.rationale: Shows the continuum Lagrangian with kinetic minus stretching terms.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the Lagrangian is kinetic energy minus potential energy

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_16.png
assets.rationale: Shows the endpoint force and the finite-difference replacement used in Newton's law.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the derivative of X with respect to sigma times delta sigma
assets.caption_hint: Force on the final mass point

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_17.png
assets.rationale: Shows the vanishing endpoint slope reached from the finite-acceleration limit.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the derivative has to go to zero at the end

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_18.png
assets.rationale: Shows the cosine expansion of an open-string coordinate with Neumann endpoints.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: expand X in a cosine series

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_19.png
assets.rationale: Shows the kinetic term after orthogonality has diagonalized the mode sums.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: only the terms with n equals m survive

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_20.png
assets.rationale: Shows sine orthogonality in the stretching contribution.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: integral of sine n sigma sine m sigma

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_21.png
assets.rationale: Shows the independent oscillator Lagrangians and the identification omega_n=n.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the frequency is n

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_22.png
assets.rationale: Shows the corrected count of five states at the second excitation level.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: there are five states

assets.name: lecture_02_figure_23.png
assets.rationale: Shows an open string bringing its endpoints together and becoming a closed loop.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: an open string can turn into a closed string
